steps.label: Out-cross
steps.why: Both animals are of one breed, so the breed is kept while the close relationship is avoided.
common_mistakes: Saying an out-cross uses two breeds. It uses one.
Leaving out the four to six generation rule.
steps.memory_tip: Out-cross: same breed, no shared ancestor.

steps.label: Cross-breed
steps.why: Here two different breeds are combined so that the good qualities of both appear in the offspring.
common_mistakes: Saying a cross-breed uses one breed. It uses two.
Leaving out that superior animals are chosen.
